study.question: Observation: the incumbent g0-r0031-adapter_context_only and its same-seed g0-r0033-all_aux_context bridge reach click AUC0.6670575100; the none bridge is0.6668051957. At the existing history_1_16 slice, all vs none is0.6256457923 vs0.6263637549 (delta -0.0007179626; n461684, pos28818, neg432866). At history_17_64 it is0.6480546855 vs0.6478679251 (delta +0.0001867605; n1001754,pos55298,neg946456); at history_gt64 it is0.6714842864 vs0.6707394021 (delta +0.0007448843; n1401885,pos50957,neg1350928). Empty history n6444,pos427,neg6017 improves0.5860635304 to0.5880866818 despite the zero local residual, illustrating cross-impression/normalization transfer. Can preserving auxiliary adapter context edges only on rows with >16 valid events improve whole-validation click AUC over the all-row incumbent at unchanged parameter capacity and justified measured cost? This boundary is selected prospectively from exploratory validation diagnostics, not training-derived confirmation.
study.hypothesis: Auxiliary shaping of shared context through the task-specific compressed-history correction may have heterogeneous value across context activation rows. Allowing this backward edge on >16-event rows while stopping it on <=16-event rows may retain the incumbent longer-history ranking benefit while reducing short-history interference. This is an edge-topology hypothesis, not a claim that longer-history labels are intrinsically better or that a slice contrast identifies supervision sources. Keep all three auxiliary tasks enabled: round33 cart/fav-only0.6668914774 and buy-only0.6666426317 both trail all0.6670575100; their exploratory task-group interaction is +0.0003285966, with none0.6668051957. Other trajectories constrain the proposal: direct compressed task retrieval in g0-r0006-compressed_task0.6591942389 lost to source g2-r0004-context_only0.6606469405 and event task retrieval g0-r0006-events_task/g3-r0003-embedding_item_primary0.6601633627; more elaborate cubic summary g0-r0019-cubic_ordered0.6657048856 lost to duplicate0.6659300360. g0-r0028-dispatch_folded and g0-r0028-bank_folded have identical click AUC0.6668445431 with wall353.417 vs368.831s. Folding itself is not a numerical-equivalence result: g0-r0027-support_folded vs g0-r0027-support_full_bridge is AUC0.6668445431 vs0.6667535438, wall367.840 vs364.136s. Unblocking both auxiliary adapter item inputs in g0-r0032-adapter_items_both0.6661895287 lost to item-blocked0.6670575100. These unsuccessful branches are retained, not mechanism refutations. No current runtime execution error is reported.

nearest_work.difference: Closest local architecture. Retain all learned modules and introduce only two fixed history-row backward-edge switches. All/none bridge g0-r0033-all_aux_context/no_aux_context; no task-subset selection or added representations.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.13537v2 (STEM, primary paper; section The STEM-Net Model, Eq4-7, PDFp3-4 inspected)
nearest_work.difference: STEM uses shared/task-specific embeddings and experts, forwarding other-task experts with stopped backward edges. Forward/backward asymmetry is established prior work. Here one inherited context representation has history-conditioned adapter-input edges; no new embedding tables, experts or learned forward gate. Conditional-sharing novelty remains unverified.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1812.02224v2 (Du et al., primary paper; section2-3, Eq4-6 inspected)
nearest_work.difference: This work adapts auxiliary shared-parameter updates using task-gradient cosine alignment. The proposed control uses an input-only fixed validity-count predicate at one intermediate edge, without gradient similarity estimation, adaptive loss weights or a modified host optimizer. No convergence guarantee is transferred.

Task-aware feature interaction via proxies and heterogeneous/homogeneous blocks is relevant unified-model background. No proxy token, attention block or learned broadcast is imported. This study changes training edges of the existing compressed task adapter.

Retain the field/four-task adaptation of local activation and native Dice; the upstream Dice implementation uses BatchNorm1d and therefore couples rows. Baseline is not an exact original-paper reproduction. No normalization or regularization change is proposed.

inherited_components: Complete incumbent field embeddings, action-aware DIN scorer, four towers, zero-output-initialized task residual bank and initialization/RNG order.
Ten fixed temporal blocks; uniform and feedback-stratified history compression; five target-match/ordinal summaries and match counts from authorized inputs.
Attached rotated support, folded scorer arithmetic, primary auxiliary population, direct adapter dispatch and fully pruned evaluation.
All auxiliary task adapters train; direct tower context, item/action and scorer backward ownership remain incumbent. Sum four unweighted BCEs and host sparse/dense optimizers are unchanged.
study.proposed_difference: Add boolean architecture config aux_adapter_short_context_grad and aux_adapter_long_context_grad. During training, derive long_context_rows=(mask.bool().sum(1,keepdim=True)>16), using the original 100-position validity mask, and select the enabled row family. Immediately before each auxiliary residual adapter, use torch.where(allowed_rows,context,context.detach()) for the mixed cells. All/none use identity/detach fast paths to preserve the original anchor graphs. Evaluation never gates. The four standalone modules enumerate (short,long)=(false,true),(true,false),(true,true),(false,false). No rows or losses are removed; all learned modules still see every batch. No extra parameters, buffers, sample metadata or RNG. The original zero-history multiplier makes empty-row adapter context edges locally inactive. This is a prospective implementation, not a new measured model.
predictions: Implementation prediction: at a fixed state and input, all four cells have identical forward probabilities and Dice buffer updates; train/eval masks, outputs and checkpoint structure remain inherited. Both bridge cells reproduce their prior trajectories within host-established BF16 tolerances.

Jacobian prediction: after making the initially zero final adapter weights nonzero in a disposable host diagnostic, the auxiliary adapter-to-context Jacobian is zero on blocked rows and retained on enabled rows; click gradients at the same state are invariant. Auxiliary adapter/tower parameters still receive their task gradients. Score/item edges stay blocked. Use mixed host fixtures with history lengths0,1,16,17,64,65,100 and noncontiguous masks; exact16 must be short and exact17 longer. Verify train/eval/checkpoint round trips, valid empty-history outputs and BF16 finite probabilities/gradients without mutating the training run initialization.

Prospective quality prediction: context_gt16 exceeds context_all in full-population validation click AUC, improves history_1_16 AUC and retains the >64-history benefit; context_gt16 exceeds context_none. Report original four slices with positive/negative counts and all four task AUC/Logloss. No pooled <=16 AUC is fabricated from slice AUCs.

Report factorial edge effects and interaction rather than inferring additivity from the all/none comparison. Parameter counts remain32129765 total/336549 dense; measured training/inference wall time, allocated GPU time, peak memory, examples, throughput and p50/p95 latency are host outcomes, not estimated gains.
falsifiers: If context_gt16 does not exceed context_all, selective quality improvement is unsupported for this implementation. If it fails to exceed context_none, retaining the longer-row edge lacks useful complementarity.

If shorter-history ranking does not improve or longer-history benefit is lost, the proposed slice tradeoff prediction fails even if aggregate AUC rises. If only the complementary context_le16 wins, revise the direction rather than reinterpreting the original prediction.

Nonmatching fixed-state probabilities/buffers, wrong mask boundary, forbidden input usage, a zero-gradient probe caused only by unopened adapter initialization, changed capacity or failed bridges invalidate mechanism interpretation until repaired.

Any eventual gain that disappears with paired repetitions, a matched-active-row-count/dose control, or measured equal-compute comparison supports a weaker optimization explanation, not history-specific transfer. A single small validation gain cannot establish a general mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Single frozen seed and a validation-informed threshold chosen from an existing slice boundary; no claim of confirmatory independence or significance.
Gate populations differ in row count, gradient magnitude, embedding coverage and history composition; improvement need not be caused by history information itself.
Native Dice BatchNorm couples examples; active context rows can receive gradients originating from losses on other rows. This does not isolate whose labels are useful.
Shared feature values across impressions, sparse Adagrad state and dense global clipping can transfer effects across cohorts and heads. No complete optimizer/parameter isolation.
Changed autograd work may change measured training cost; equal parameter count is not equal compute.
Observed slice differences can reflect changed between-user ranking, calibration, repeated feature identities or normalization trajectories rather than short-row gradients being harmful.

The incumbent improves click while its cart/fav/buy AUC0.778674/0.803178/0.756152 trail DIN0.849070/0.864897/0.870182. Selection stays click-based but auxiliary regressions must remain visible; this is not an all-task improvement claim.
Released whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots and official_offline delayed feedback are inherited assumptions; outcomes do not establish online point-in-time validity.
